data.name: Gran
data.gender_notes: Gran is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Celtic word ‘gran’, meaning gracious, courteous, or gentle. This name was often given to girls in ancient Celtic cultures, reflecting their values of kindness and respect. The name Gran carries the meaning “Gracious, gentle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gran usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
